description: Story mission/demo catalogue and launch hub: presentation, pre/post battle scripts, mission and room links, relation changes, unlocks and rewards for each story demo.

ID.technical: FName row key in StoryDemoDataTables (DTM +0x8C0), exposed by the export as "ID" and stored at row +0x08. Used as the StudioStoryDemoStates_5E0 progress key (0 = unseen/unstarted, >=2 = cleared), as Story_ResolveDemoLaunch's OutRequest.Name2C, for chapter membership checks, and for relation-UI mission list entries. Main demos are identified by an Id ending in "M" (case-insensitive). StudioStoryDemoSeen_630 is a separate seen-state map keyed by ShortStory ids, not by this id.

MissionIndex.simple: Display number of the mission within its chapter.
MissionIndex.technical: int32 (row +0x10), default 0 in the constructor. GameScript_ShowTitle passes it to UGameStoryDemoWidget::SetupTitle, which inserts it as a two-digit zero-padded integer text parameter; exported values are 0..114 and unique across the table.

Id_StoryMissionTitle.simple: Localized-text id for the mission/demo title.
Id_StoryMissionTitle.technical: FName (row +0x14). Used by mission-select content/detail, character-select mission info, relation mission list items, system dialogs, shop sale descriptions, collection archive movie items and the script ShowTitle command. The exported id is also a key in every exported language's StoryTextDataTable (115/115 rows).

Id_StoryMissionDetail.simple: Localized-text id for the mission explanation.
Id_StoryMissionDetail.technical: FName (row +0x1C). GameStoryMissionSelectWidget sets it on the detail explanation text; exported values use the pattern <demo id>_EXPLANATION, and all 115 are present in every exported StoryTextDataTable locale.

ThumbnailFileName.technical: FName. GameScript_ShowTitle dynamically loads it for the title image; UGameScriptPlayer also adds it to WidgetTexture loader names when the running script is this demo's pre- or post-battle script.

SmallThumbnailFileName.technical: FName (row +0x2C). Used as the WidgetTexture loader key for mission-select content entries and installed as the ReplacementTexture material parameter on open.

Id_Script_PreBattle.simple: Script to play before the story battle.
Id_Script_PreBattle.technical: FName (row +0x34). Story_GetPreBattleScriptId returns it (retail dereferences the row unchecked); Story_ResolveDemoLaunch uses non-None to route to StoryDemoPreBattle and resolves that script's levels, while a None value with a mission and a valid playable index routes directly to BattleStory (an invalid playable index instead routes to StoryCharacterSelect). Script commands and the script player also match running script names against this field for DLC checks and thumbnail preload.

Id_Script_PostBattle.simple: Script to play after the story battle.
Id_Script_PostBattle.technical: FName (row +0x3C). Story_GetPostBattleScriptId returns it; after a won story battle, BattleStory requests StoryDemoPostBattle with the script's levels when non-None. Also used in DLC-script detection and script thumbnail preload.

Id_StoryMission.simple: StoryMission row to run for this demo.
Id_StoryMission.technical: FName (row +0x44). Story_ResolveDemoLaunch copies it into FStudioPhaseRequest.Name34 and uses it to fetch the mission/first wave/playable character and battle level; the result screen reads the saved rank for this id (0xFF when there is no mission or no record). None means no battle mission: the launch uses the room placement or the pre-battle script path. The demo row's mission also drives objective/mission-task lookup through Story_GetDemoMissionTask_13096F0. In the export, every non-None value equals the row ID.

Id_StoryRoomCondition.simple: Room-condition row used to pick this demo's story room layout.
Id_StoryRoomCondition.technical: FName (row +0x4C). Story_PickRoomPlacement_13097C0 starts from ROOM_COND_0000. If the ChapterIndex-6 chapter still has a pending main demo, it scans all chapter demo lists and keeps the last cleared demo's non-None condition; otherwise, with bPickWhenAllCleared=true it uniformly picks one of all demos' non-None conditions, and with false it returns the cached StudioStoryRoomPlacementId_D18. The chosen condition is looked up in StoryRoomConditionDataTables and supplies weighted room-placement ids. None entries are ignored.

Id_StoryCharaRelateChange.simple: Relation-change rows applied on first clear of this demo.
Id_StoryCharaRelateChange.technical: TArray<FName> with 12 exported slots. OnStoryDemoFirstClear skips None, finds each StoryCharaRelateChange row and adds its directed deltas to StudioNestedNameInts_770; the relation UI and relation-news check filter those rows by character pair, and the result dialog aggregates them. Non-None entries also count toward story completion percentage.

Id_StoryDemo.simple: Prerequisite child demos shown as open conditions.
Id_StoryDemo.technical: TArray<FName> with two exported slots. Mission-select content shows one open-condition text per valid non-None entry (as a MISSION text parameter). MainMenuStory_IsDemoAvailable requires every non-None child to have demo state >=2 before the parent can be newly available; the release filters additionally require at least one non-None child for progress-flag chapters. None slots are ignored.

Id_Character_Release.simple: Characters unlocked by clearing this demo.
Id_Character_Release.technical: TArray<FName> (row +0x78) with three exported slots. On first clear a non-None entry marks the demo in StudioMissionInts_6D0; MainMenuStory turns values 1 -> 2 (newly released) and collects the ids for the character-select/release notifications. Story_HasNewCharaRelate uses the same map plus this list to determine which characters are released before checking pair news.

Id_Character_Pair_Release_1.simple: First halves of character pairs unlocked by this demo.
Id_Character_Pair_Release_1.technical: TArray<FName> with nine exported slots, parallel to Id_Character_Pair_Release_2. A non-None first entry marks the demo in StudioNameInts_720; MainMenuStory builds released pairs from the two parallel arrays and the relation detail/list uses the same pairs to decide which character relationships are visible. Index-wise loops break when the parallel array runs out and skip None entries.

Id_Character_Pair_Release_2.simple: Second halves of character pairs unlocked by this demo.
Id_Character_Pair_Release_2.technical: TArray<FName> parallel to Id_Character_Pair_Release_1; each valid (First, Second) is added to the released pair collections, with new pairs removed when they match an already released pair in either order. The relation detail checks both slots against the selected pair. Pair-release slots are counted separately in story completion percentage and gate relation-news checks.

Id_ItemSet.simple: Reward item sets for this demo.
Id_ItemSet.technical: TArray<FName> with three exported slots. Index 0 is the clear reward, indices n>0 correspond to mission tasks n-1: Story_GetDemoRewardItem_130A230 verifies the task detail text exists for n>0, resolves Id_ItemSet[index] in ItemSetDataTables and returns the first item and quantity (quantity -1 on failure). MainMenuStory grants index 0 when clear state 2 is promoted to 3 and index n+1 when task flag n is 1 and promoted to 2, using GameShop_AddItemSetOnce(..., 2); None item-set slots are skipped.

notes: The pre/post script fields also serve as reverse keys: GameScript_IsDlcScript, GameScript_ShowTitle and UGameScriptPlayer find the demo row by matching a running script name against either field.

Many consumers deliberately dereference the found row without a null check (e.g. Story_GetPreBattleScriptId and the room-condition scans); missing ids can fault in reconstructed retail-shaped code rather than degrade gracefully.

The export has 115 rows, one StoryDemoDataTable asset, and a unique MissionIndex range of 0..114. No numbered shards or localization variants of this exact table were exported; language-specific StoryTextDataTable files are separate text tables. Every row is listed exactly once in StoryChapterDataTable, every non-None Id_StoryMission equals its row ID, and all non-None mission, room-condition, relation-change and item-set references resolve within the supplied exports.

Runtime behavior is verified against the reconstructed C++ sources and exported data only. No retail Blueprint assets were provided and the editor was not launched, so no exhaustive Blueprint-use or runtime execution claim is made.

usages.detail: Story_ResolveDemoLaunch chooses phase 15/16/23, battle level, playable character and levels from the demo row and its linked mission/script.
Story_PickRoomPlacement derives the room condition from demo progress and linked demos.
Applies character and pair releases plus relation changes on first clear.
Computes releases, seen states, rewards and available demos from all demo rows.
Builds the relation detail's mission list from demos referencing the selected pair's relation changes.
Shows the script title using demo title text, mission index and thumbnail.
Reverse-matches running script ids against both script fields to preload the demo thumbnail as a WidgetTexture.
Counts non-None character-release, pair-release and relation-change ids toward the story completion percentage.
